# Webman (webman.dev): Nicolas Desjardins, AI automation and full-stack development

> Webman is the working name of Nicolas (Nick) Desjardins, an applied AI developer and senior full-stack developer in the Greater Montreal Area, Quebec, Canada, working in English and French. webman.dev is his official site. He builds AI automation for businesses in Quebec and across Canada: document processing that ends manual data entry, private knowledge-base search that quotes its sources, custom AI agents that wait for a person before risky steps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI assistants to existing company systems. He created the open-source NextBlock CMS and its Cortex AI MCP server, and has run production web systems for New Roots Herbal Inc. for 8+ years. He takes contracts and is open to full-time roles and agency placements, on site or hybrid in Montreal, or fully remote across Canada, the US and the rest of the world.

## AI automation services in Canada

Each service is tied to public, dated proof. "Measured" figures come from saved benchmark records and recorded runs; "track record" is employment work attributed to New Roots Herbal Inc.

- Document processing and data entry automation: invoices, purchase orders, forms and incoming emails become validated records in an accounting system, ERP or database, with no retyping. Measured: 21 of 21 test invoices fully correct on the 7 October 2026 benchmark.
- Private knowledge base AI and internal copilots (RAG): answers from a company's own procedures, manuals and regulatory documents that quote the exact passage and page, and decline when the documents do not cover the question. Measured: 6 of 6 recorded questions answered with verified quotes, 1 of 1 out-of-scope question declined (14 October 2026).
- Custom AI agents with human approval: multi-step back-office workflows (data lookups, drafting, compliance checks) that pause for a person before anything is sent, published or changed. Measured: 6 scenarios recorded on 15 October 2026, every dispatch behind a recorded human decision.
- MCP servers and LLM integration: company systems exposed to AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through the Model Context Protocol, with scoped tokens, typed tools, confirmation before changes, and provider fallback. Measured: NextBlock's Cortex AI MCP server has 56 tools and is listed in the official MCP Registry.
- Full-stack Next.js, Supabase and e-commerce development: Next.js, React and TypeScript applications, Supabase and PostgreSQL back ends, headless CMS, custom API integrations, Laravel and PHP platforms, and enterprise e-commerce migrations. Track record: 30+ websites migrated with zero downtime and hosting costs cut by over 40% at New Roots Herbal Inc.
- AI quality gate (LLMOps): a gateway in front of every AI call that answers repeated questions from a semantic cache, sends easy questions to cheap models and hard ones to strong models, records what each answer cost, and blocks a change in CI when the answers get worse. Measured on 23 October 2026: 0 of 78 look-alike questions served a wrong cached answer, 79.8% of list-price model spend avoided on a 250-question replay.

French search terms he serves: automatisation IA Montréal et Québec, consultant en intelligence artificielle et en automatisation des processus d'affaires, développeur full-stack senior.

## Flagship product: NextBlock CMS and Cortex AI

- [NextBlock CMS](https://nextblock.dev): the open-source, full-stack AI-native CMS for Next.js 16, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS. Nicolas Desjardins is its creator, designer, and lead developer.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/nextblock-cms/nextblock): Nx monorepo.
- [Live sandbox](https://cms.nextblock.dev/): demo@nextblock.dev / password, resets every 15 minutes.
- Install: npm create nextblock@latest
- Scale (October 2026): 200k+ lines of TypeScript; 8 npm packages at v0.21.3 (create-nextblock and @nextblock-cms/ui, utils, db, editor, sdk, ecom, cortex); 191 CLI releases since October 2025; 11.5k CLI downloads in the 30 days to 7 October 2026; 620+ commits; 146 Vitest test files; 21 forward-only SQL migrations.
- Architecture: every content block is a JSONB row in Supabase PostgreSQL under row-level security; data-driven custom block types render with no rebuild; Live Draft Mode and revisions; linked EN/FR translations; SEO graded as you type. Public routes are React Server Components.
- Cortex AI: the CMS is an MCP server (Streamable HTTP, scoped bearer tokens, 56 tools, confirmation-gated mutations) listed in the official MCP Registry as dev.nextblock/nextblock. OpenRouter routing through the Vercel AI SDK with free-model fallback. AES-256-GCM encrypted bring-your-own-key storage.
- Commerce Pro: Stripe for physical goods, Freemius for digital licensing, multi-currency with rounding modes, scheduled sales, shipping zones, taxes, inventory, orders.
- Distribution: one-click Vercel deploy with zero environment variables (Supabase provisioned and keys injected before the first build), self-hosted Docker stack (Postgres, GoTrue, PostgREST, Kong, MinIO), npm run update applied as a git three-way merge.
- Performance: 100/100 Lighthouse in all four categories on the production build (0.3 s FCP, 0.8 s LCP, 0 ms TBT, 0 CLS).

## AI projects (open source)

- Invoice Extraction Service (Phase 1, shipped): an asynchronous FastAPI microservice that turns messy documents into a schema-validated invoice record. A free primary model cascades to a second provider on rate limits, timeouts, or schema exceptions, at zero marginal cost. [Project page](https://nickdesjardins.github.io/Invoice-Extraction-Service/), [source](https://github.com/nickdesjardins/Invoice-Extraction-Service).
- Context-Aware Hybrid Compliance Retrieval Engine (Phase 2, shipped): answers from SOPs and regulatory manuals only by quoting the source. Vector and keyword search run in one PostgreSQL statement and are fused, a cross-encoder keeps the best passages, and every quote is checked against the stored document. Measured on 14 October 2026: 6 of 6 recorded questions answered with verified citations, 1 of 1 out-of-corpus question declined, 441 MB peak memory on a 512 MB instance. [Project page](https://nickdesjardins.github.io/hybrid-knowledge-rag/), [source](https://github.com/nickdesjardins/hybrid-knowledge-rag), [live demo](https://hybrid-retrieval-engine.onrender.com/) (free tier, about a minute to wake).
- Autonomous Multi-Agent Operations and Marketing Pipeline (Phase 3, shipped): a cyclic LangGraph state machine that turns one inventory SKU into channel marketing copy for a licensed Natural Health Product and sends nothing until a person signs it off. Violations loop back to the writer a bounded number of times, then the graph pauses on a PostgreSQL checkpoint; approval fires one HMAC-signed webhook. Measured on 15 October 2026: 3 of 3 dispatches behind a recorded human decision, 504 hermetic tests, $0.00 marginal cost per run. [Project page](https://nickdesjardins.github.io/autonomous-operation-marketing/), [source](https://github.com/nickdesjardins/autonomous-operation-marketing), [live demo](https://multi-agent-ops-pipeline.onrender.com/).
- Production LLMOps Gateway: Evaluation CI/CD and Latency Optimization (Phase 4, shipped): a FastAPI gateway in front of every model call. A Redis 8 semantic cache with a contrast check that refuses look-alike questions, a complexity router across a light and a heavy chain of free models with failover and self-repair, SSE streaming, token ceilings, and a Langfuse trace with tokens and cost per request. DeepEval and Ragas judge a 37-case golden set in GitHub Actions and block a pull request past 5% hallucination or below 0.95 faithfulness. Measured on 23 October 2026: 0 of 78 look-alikes served a wrong cached answer at the 0.96 threshold, 79.8% of list-price spend avoided on a 250-question replay, $0.00 marginal cost per request. [Project page](https://nickdesjardins.github.io/LLMOps-gateway-evals/), [source](https://github.com/nickdesjardins/LLMOps-gateway-evals), [live demo](https://llmops-gateway-q68n.onrender.com/).

## Production web work

- [newrootsherbal.com](https://newrootsherbal.com/): employer work for New Roots Herbal Inc. Full platform revamp on Laravel 13, a custom PHP CMS and e-commerce store written from scratch, with a Google Maps store locator and a real-time inventory system.
- Eighteen campaign and education microsites for New Roots Herbal product lines (employer work): standalone Next.js sites such as [vitamins.newrootsherbal.com](https://vitamins.newrootsherbal.com/), [probiotics.newrootsherbal.com](https://probiotics.newrootsherbal.com/), [coughandcold.ca](https://www.coughandcold.ca/) and [prostateperform.ca](https://prostateperform.ca/), plus Laravel-served pages such as [newrootsherbal.com/cardiac-health](https://newrootsherbal.com/cardiac-health).
- [MusiqueSD](https://www.musiquesd.com/): independent client site. Bilingual FR/EN marketing site for a Montreal recording studio, DJ and event animation business.
- [Ryūgū: Ten Nights to the Dragon Palace](https://japan.webman.dev/): independent. A chaptered travel companion for an eleven-day voyage around Japan and Jeju.
- [Thieves' Cant Translator](https://www.thethievescant.com/): independent. A D&D 5e rogue's companion that translates English or French into Thieves' Cant.
- [pcsquad.ca](https://pcsquad.ca/): own business, founded 2012. The bilingual site of Nicolas's first company, a computer repair and website shop he owned and ran from 2012 to 2018.
- [Civalgo Punch](https://civalgo-punch.vercel.app/) and [React Hooks Guide](https://react-hooks-delta-umber.vercel.app/): experiments kept online for show.
